name: Ripple
author: Charles Vestal
tagline: Droplets and currents for the FM-1
description: Ripple turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an instrument you can reprogram without reflashing. Its instruments are droplets, which are small programs written in Lua. Fifteen are built in, from a drum machine to generative bells, a looper and the Game of Life. Droplets make their sounds with currents, written in Faust, Pd or C, and any droplet can load and chain them. To add your own, put the FM-1 in disk mode. It shows up on your computer as a USB drive, and you copy your files onto it.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). Lua 5.4 (MIT, Lua.org, PUC-Rio). Currents in Faust (GRAME) and in Pd, compiled by hvcc (Wasted Audio, continuing Enzien Audio's Heavy).
